![Rhodium Plating - Jewelry Services Center](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/09171306-2330-0066-0000-13d20bcfb687:4)
Rhodium plating is `a thin, protective layer of a rare, silvery-white precious metal electroplated onto rings to create a bright, mirror-like finish and prevent tarnish`.[[1]](https://www.yatesjewelers.com/what-is-rhodium-plating.html)[[2]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/what-is-rhodium-plating/)

### Why Rings Need Rhodium Plating

- **White Gold:** Pure gold is naturally yellow. White gold is mixed with other metals and given a [Brilliant Earth](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/what-is-rhodium-plating/) rhodium coating to achieve a crisp, icy-white color.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ujjPSpEgLro)[[2]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/en-gb/guides/what-is-rhodium-plating/)
- **Silver and Platinum:** Plating brightens sterling silver and protects it from oxidation, while adding extra scratch resistance to softer metals.[[1]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/what-is-rhodium-plating/)[[2]](https://www.yatesjewelers.com/what-is-rhodium-plating.html)
- **Hypoallergenic:** It creates a safe barrier between your skin and underlying alloys like nickel.[[1]](https://goldzenn.com/blogs/news/rhodium-dipping-the-ultimate-upgrade-for-your-silver-and-white-gold-chains)[[2]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/what-is-rhodium-plating/)

### Maintenance and Lifespan

- **Wear Time:** On frequently worn rings, plating usually lasts between 6 months and 2 years before the base metal begins to show through.
- **Re-plating:** When the white shine fades or a yellowish tint appears on white gold, a professional jeweler can clean, polish, and re-dip the ring.[[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DQ5mIDHjEze/?hl=en)[[2]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/what-is-rhodium-plating/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ujjPSpEgLro)

If you're thinking about getting a ring plated or re-plated, tell me:

- What **metal** is the ring made of?
- How **often** do you wear it?

I can help you estimate how long the plating will last or what care steps to take.
